evals.name: freshbooks-multiplatform-gated-matrix
evals.prompt: I need to spin up a batch of on-brand ad variants for a FreshBooks prospecting push across Meta feed, LinkedIn, and TikTok — with separate angles for small-business owners vs accountants. It's fintech, so nothing can make a compliance-risky claim (no guaranteed outcomes, etc.). Set up the variant matrix, write the copy to each platform's spec, and gate it so I know which ones are actually safe to ship.
evals.expected_output: A format×pillar×audience variant matrix for FreshBooks across Meta/LinkedIn/TikTok with audience-differentiated copy written to each platform's char limits, every variant run through a compliance gate with a shippable/blocked verdict and a brand_qa_pass_rate.

evals.name: klaviyo-lift-handoff
evals.prompt: We're running an AI-creative-vs-agency test for a Klaviyo summer campaign. Produce the AI variant batch and give me the production-efficiency numbers I'd plug into an incrementality readout to prove lift over the agency baseline — how many shippable, cost per asset, brand-QA pass rate, time to launch.
evals.expected_output: An AI variant batch for Klaviyo plus a production-efficiency / lift-handoff block (assets, cost_per_asset, brand_qa_pass_rate, time_to_launch_days) shaped to feed an AI-vs-agency incrementality experiment.
